Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. What're you up to？
▲小早川＊▲. Just taking a walk, I guess.
Hmm. So basically, you're just wandering around aimlessly.
Well, I'm gonna get going.
Yeah. I'm gonna wander around a little longer before heading home.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲!
Kobayakawa
You startled me. What are you doing out here？
Just scouting around. Seeing if there are any good date spots.
You mean... for a date with me, right？
Obviously. I'll find us a good spot.
Heh, guess I shouldn't ask for details then. See ya.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Heh, surprised you, huh？
▲小早川＊▲. You scared me... What brings you here？
My little brother begged me to bring him here to play.
Where is he？
He found a friend and went to play over there. His friend's mom offered to keep an eye on him too, so I'm taking a little walk.
Anyway, I should head back soon.
Yeah. See you.
Kobayakawa
Thought I recognized you from behind...
Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲. Are you by yourself？
My dad dragged me along today. Kept going on about how he "just had to see it." Like, go by yourself then.
Nothing wrong with some father-daughter time. ...So where is your dad？
Over there watching the movie. I got bored, so I walked out. Guess I'll head back soon, though.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲, fancy meeting you here. Here to see a movie？
Nope. Just stopped by to pick up a program I wanted.
Oh yeah？ Did you get it？
Yeah. An actor my mom likes is in it, so it's a present for her.
(They really get along well.)
Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲. Did you come to see a movie？
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Decided not to, though.
Why？
My little brother called and threw a fit telling me to come home and play with him.
Haha, I see. Being a good big sister, huh.
Kobayakawa
Oh, trying to bulk up or something？
Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲! Wait, are you working out too, ▲小早川＊▲？
As if. Just passing through. ...Thought maybe you'd be here？
I see. That makes me happy.
It was just a hunch. ...Quit grinning like that.
Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲. What are you up to？
Kobayakawa
Oh, good timing. Do you know if the swimming school here has a good reputation？
A good reputation？ No idea... Why？
My little brother says he wants to take lessons. I got stuck scouting the place out, so I'll pass the job on to you.
That's a little too much responsibility for me. I'll pass.
No need to be so modest. Anyway, I'm counting on you.
(She says that, but still...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Did you come here to work out？
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. ...Yeah, don't you ever get a sudden urge to work out？
No.
Guess not.
Not at all. I do get the urge to devour a pile of books sometimes, though. ...Oh, now I feel like reading. I'm heading home.
(Guess she didn't actually have any business around here.)
Kobayakawa
Heh, I knew it was you.
Oh, you're here too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Doing some shopping？
Just a little, yeah. What about you？ You came all the way out here—what are you buying？ Don't tell me it's canned mackerel.
Of course not. I'm just window-shopping.
Then you should've invited me along. ...Well, I still have errands to run, so I couldn't have come anyway.
(Oh, so she's busy after all...)
▲小早川＊▲! What a coincidence.
Kobayakawa
...Oh. Unfortunately, you're not the guy I want right now...
Eh！？
My little brother wandered off, so I'm looking for him.
Oh, it's your mom.
Hello...？ Yeah. Oh, you found him？ Okay, got it. Bye.
Sounds like they found my brother... Anyway, I'm gonna go.
I see, that's a relief. Bye.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing here by yourself？
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Just thought I'd look around a bit. Aren't you by yourself too？
I'm running an errand for my dad. Out of nowhere he told me to go pick up the shoes he ordered. Apparently he absolutely needs them today.
Oh, I see. Sounds like a hassle.
Honestly, he's such a high-maintenance dad...
Kobayakawa
Whoa... What are you doing here？
▲小早川＊▲! You surprised me too. What are you up to？
Nothing really. Just passing through. Were you interested in today's event？
Hmm... Kind of yes, kind of no.
So you were just bored and wandered over？ Well, too bad—I'm busy, so I can't keep you company. See ya.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Did you come to see a show or something？
Hey! Yeah, something like that. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah, I heard a rumor there was a Volvavin show going on here, so I came to check... Looks like it was a false alarm, though.
Wait, you wanted to watch it, ▲小早川＊▲？ Not your little brother？
I promised I'd watch it for him and reenact the whole thing in vivid detail. Anyway, my brother's waiting, so I'm heading home.
(▲小早川＊▲ reenacting it in vivid detail... I kinda wanted to see that.)
(Huh... Isn't that ▲小早川＊▲？)
▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Don't shout so loud.
Were you looking for someone？
Yeah. I thought I spotted a musician who's visiting Japan, but I lost them.
Haha, chasing after stars？ Who knew ▲小早川＊▲ was actually...
What？
...Never mind.
Kobayakawa
All right, winning streak!
▲小早川＊▲. You came here too？
Well, yeah. I have to school the locals around here every now and then.
Huh, just be careful.
It's fine. Anyway, a new challenger's here. See ya.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What a coincidence. Wanna hang out for a bit？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry, I can't... A friend just called, and I promised we'd meet up now.
I see... Bad timing, huh.
I don't want them saying I ignore my friends for my boyfriend. You wouldn't want that either, right？
(Yeah, it's better to have a girlfriend who values her friends.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. At the arcade by yourself？
You caught me. Uh... I was thinking of getting some secret practice in.
If you just asked me, I'd coach you myself.
That defeats the purpose. I want to practice on my own and surprise you, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hmm. Well, I'll look forward to it. I'm always open to a challenge anytime.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, ▲Kobayaka＊▲.
Were you always interested in home electronics？
Not really. I mostly just look around thinking how handy it'd be to have this stuff at home.
Home appliances, huh. I have some business on another floor, so sorry, I'm gonna head out.
(Probably the games or the audio-visual section...)
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
Oh, you're here too？ Just killing time？
Don't assume I'm killing time. You're not wrong, though... What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I actually have things to do here. I didn't just come because I was bored.
Things to do？
Clocking in some family time. It's part of the job as a daughter.
(She sounds like a salaryman.)
Kobayakawa
Hey mister, you get 20% back in reward points right now.
Whoa! ...You scared me.
Hehe... I was surprised when I spotted you, too.
Out shopping？
No, just killing time before a family dinner. I'm meeting up with them nearby soon.
I see. Have a good time.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲!
Kobayakawa
Oh, it's you. What's up？
Nothing in particular, I just...
Oh, okay. I'm busy checking the imports right now, so I don't have time to chat.
Gotcha. Sorry to bother you.
No, sorry about that.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey.
We just ran into each other by chance. You could at least act a little surprised.
Haha, at this point, running into you anywhere wouldn't surprise me.
...By the way, you do realize this is the Western music section？
Well... studying up, I guess？
That's the spirit. If there's anything you don't get, just ask me. I'll teach you all about it.
Kobayakawa
Whoa...
Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What are you doing in a place like this？
What do you mean, "a place like this"...？ It's a CD shop. It's totally normal for me to be here.
Yeah, but this is the J-Pop section, you know？
Um... my little brother's... Yeah, right, there's a song my brother likes, so I came to look for it. See ya.
(Is she telling the truth？)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲. Did you come here too, ▲小早川＊▲？
No, I was just passing by. More importantly, are you actually... a lolicon？
Where'd you get that idea？!
Hmm, so you're not？
I'm not!
You were standing right out in the open in front of a cute girl poster, so I figured you must be.
(It was just a coincidence...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Good timing. ...Hey, are you a regular here？ Do you know the staff？
Not really, why？ What's up？
They have a toy my little brother's been wanting, and I was wondering if I could ask them to put it on hold.
Oh yeah？ Is it rare？ Let's go ask them, then.
Really？ Great, that's a big help.
Huh, ▲小早川＊▲？ I didn't know you came to anime shops？
Kobayakawa
Whenever I have errands around here, I take a peek inside. Sometimes they have cute cat stuff.
I see. Did you find anything good today？
I didn't really see much today. And I don't have time to look around carefully anyway.
Then I'll keep an eye out for you too.
Hehe, thanks. I'll count on you.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Whoa... ▲小早川＊▲! What are you doing here？
I'm just passing by. I've got things to do, so I can't stick around long, though...
I see. Well, shouldn't you get going, then？
You're acting awfully flustered. It's kind of suspicious.
I'm not flustered at all... Come on, you have errands to run, right？ Shouldn't you be going？
I was going to leave without you telling me. ...Still, you're definitely acting suspicious. Well, whatever.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Don't tell me you're going into this shop？
Huh？! Oh... yeah, I thought maybe I'd check it out, haha.
If you want to go in, just go right on in.
It's not like I'm dying to go in or anything... Didn't you have somewhere to be, ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, right, I did. Jeez... it's your fault for hanging around such a weird place.
(I wasn't the one holding you up...)
Kobayakawa
"Please come back soon, Master▼" ...Something like that？
▲小早川＊▲！ What are you doing？
I was thinking I might get a part-time job here. They do cat-ear events sometimes, and the whole staff wears them that day.
What, a job！？ Here？ You, ▲小早川＊▲？
...Obviously I'm kidding. You know I hate dealing with customers, right？ Anyway, I've got stuff to do, so I'm leaving.
(What a relief...)
Kobayakawa
You're pretty devout, huh.
Whoa, ▲小早川＊▲. ...It's not that I'm devout, I just wanted to come somewhere quiet.
Huh. Well, I actually kind of like it here too, so I get it.
Did you come here for a breather too, ▲小早川＊▲？
I came here to get lost in my book. At home, my little brother's too much of a distraction... So don't you bother me either.
Got it...
(It's ▲小早川＊▲. Why is she pacing around like that？)
(Whoops, I'm gonna lose sight of her！)
▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
What were you doing？
I heard a kitten mewing, so I was looking for it... Maybe it hid somewhere？
I know！ If I had some milk or something, it might come out... Okay, I'm going home to get some. Bye.
(She sure looks busy, in a way...)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲.
Out for a nice, slow walk？
Yeah, something like that. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I was taking a walk too. But my dad just got hold of me, so I have to go.
Gotcha. Let's come take it easy here together next time.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Bowling by yourself？
Yeah！ I figured it'd be nice once in a while.
Huh. Not gonna invite your girlfriend？
You'll join me？ Then let's play a game together right now.
Too bad. I've got something important to do after this.
...Figures.
▲小早川＊▲. Heading somewhere？
Kobayakawa
Oh, yeah. I have plans with a friend.
By the way, what's so fun about bowling？ All you do is roll a ball at stuff far away.
You don't just roll it. You hit the pins, knock them down...
...Assuming it even hits the pins. That's my point...
(That just takes practice...)
Kobayakawa
Oh, lonely boy spotted.
▲小早川＊▲. "Lonely"？ ...I'm actually having a good time here, you know.
Doesn't really look like it？
Then join me.
I have stuff to do, though... Well, I can watch for a little bit. Go, go, do your best.
Here I go！
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. What are you doing？
Well...
Wait, karaoke by yourself？
Uh, well... I guess that's not a bad idea.
Hmm. Well, lots of people go solo these days, apparently. Nothing wrong with that.
(Glad she didn't make fun of me...)
▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Oh, it's you. Going to karaoke？
Yeah... What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Wanna come with me if you're free？
Too bad, I'm actually busy. Ask me some other time when I'm free.
Gotcha. Next time, then.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲. What a coincidence.
Is it？ We don't live that far apart. Everyone hangs out at the same places anyway.
Well, yeah, sure. Still, it's nice running into you like this, right？
Yeah... I guess I get what you mean.
Kobayakawa
Aren't you supposed to come to places like this with your girlfriend？
▲小早川＊▲！
Hehe. And here's that girlfriend now!
Who'd you come with, ▲小早川＊▲？
My family. My little brother fell asleep though, so we've gotta head home.
I see. A nice little family outing, huh.
(It's ▲小早川＊▲... She's talking to someone.)
(Oh, looks like they're done talking.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Oh, you noticed me. Who were you talking to？
Some stranger.
Eh？
Wanted me to fill out a survey. I said no, though.
Everything okay？
Yeah. I'm mature, so I don't just kick people right away even if they get pushy.
(I hope that's true...)
▲小早川＊▲. Do you even like places like this enough to come by yourself？
Kobayakawa
A friend invited me. Says she's scouting for a date.
Huh. I'd like to do some scouting myself.
No can do today. It's just us girls planning a date from a girl's perspective.
A date spot from a girl's perspective...
You're not thinking anything weird, are you？ ...Whatever, see ya.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Where are you going？
Hey! Just thought I'd grab some tea here or something.
Oh, yeah？ I hear their new dessert is supposed to be really good.
Oh yeah？ Wanna get some with me？
I'd love to, but I can't today. Let me know how it is if you get it.
▲小早川＊▲! Heading somewhere？
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Yeah, just out and about. Anyway, do you like going to cafes alone？
I wouldn't say I love it, but... every now and then.
Hmm, don't go crying 'cause you're lonely. Your girlfriend will join you when she's free.
Oh, so you're busy.
Pretty much. See you.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey. All by yourself？
Just for now. I'm meeting up with a friend soon. What about you？
I had some free time, so I figured I'd grab some tea.
You could just drink that at home.
It tastes different from when I make it myself.
Huh. Well, whatever makes you happy. Enjoy yourself.
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
What's up？ Stopping for some tea？
No, I was just passing by. I need to head home.
Oh, okay. Sorry for holding you up.
It's fine, don't worry about it. See you later.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲. Did you come to get some tea？
No, I just had an errand nearby. Are you getting tea by yourself？
Yeah.
Huh. That's kind of grown-up of you...
Falling for me all over again？
Idiot.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Thought that was you... Hehe. Eating out？
Yeah. Eating out all the time probably isn't great for me, though.
In your case, eating out is probably healthier than living off canned mackerel at home.
...It's not like canned mackerel is all I eat.
At least try to order something well-balanced. See you later.
▲小早川＊▲！
Kobayakawa
Oh. Eating here today？
Yeah. I really like the food here.
Oh, really？
Though nothing beats what you make for me, ▲小早川＊▲.
Idiot. Are you trying to flatter me？ I'm leaving.
Kobayakawa
Where are you going？
Whoa... You startled me. Where are you headed, ▲小早川＊▲？
Out to eat with my family. My dad actually has time today for once.
Oh yeah？ You're not with them right now, though？
We're meeting at the restaurant. Anyway, I'm off.
Yeah, see you.
Kobayakawa
Must be nice. Just eating all by yourself without a care...
Huh？ Oh, hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Food tastes better with family than alone, doesn't it？
Not really. They nag me to eat my vegetables, and my little brother steals my favorite side dishes...
You sound like a little kid. Your mom's cooking is good, isn't it？
Yeah, I guess. Anyway, I'm heading home for some of that good cooking.
(For all her complaining, she's pretty happy with it.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲, good timing. I was just about to go get something to eat. Wanna join me？
Too bad... I just ate a little while ago.
Then I'll eat, and you could just have some tea and dessert, ▲小早川＊▲...
Sorry, I promised I'd head over to a friend's house right now.
Oh, okay... Guess I'll give up on that, then.
Sorry. Maybe next time.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey.
Wait, did you know I was around here？
No way. It's just a coincidence.
Well, I should get going.
See you.
Kobayakawa
Huh...? What are you doing here？
What do you mean, what am I doing here...? What about you？
Geez. I asked first, so the rule is you have to answer first.
I'm... out for a walk!
So in other words, you've got nothing to do. As for me... Crap! I'm gonna be late. See ya!
(And she didn't even answer my question...)
Kobayakawa
Thanks for waiting.
▲小早川＊▲! ...Wait, did we have plans to meet up？
Hehe, just kidding. I spotted you and thought I'd catch you off guard.
Oh, come on... You had me seriously sweating that I'd forgotten our plans.
If you ever forget real plans, you're getting a kick with no mercy.
（I'd better be careful...）
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What a coincidence.
Running into each other without even planning it... Doesn't it feel like we're tied by the red string of fate？
Yeah, I think so.
W-Wait... I was only joking. When you say it with a straight face like that, it makes me embarrassed...
Since we're both here, want to just go on a date？
No can do! I've got plans. See ya.
（And there she goes...）
Kobayakawa
Yeah...
Ah.
What a coincidence, huh？ Feels kind of weird...
Tell me about it. Part of me is happy, part of me is embarrassed.
Hehe, we got carried away talking. I really need to get going.
Gotcha. See you later, then.
（I'm so bored...）
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. You're really spacing out.
Oh, ▲小早川＊▲. Are you free right now, by any chance？
Do I look like it？ Hate to break it to you, but I have to head straight home right now.
Guess things don't go my way that easily.
Hm？
Nothing, just talking to myself. See you later.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Hehe... For some reason, I had a feeling I'd run into you.
Oh yeah？ I kinda had a feeling I would too.
Really？ Since when were you such a smooth talker？
Are you okay on time？
Oh, I have to get going... Bye-bye.
Bye-bye.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲!
Kobayakawa
Ah.
Are you by yourself？
Yeah. Just running a quick errand. Mom's busy looking after my little brother.
Want me to come along？
It's fine, it's nothing big. I'd feel bad anyway. See ya.
Yeah, see ya.
(Talk about a flashy outfit...)
Kobayakawa
You were just looking at that woman, weren't you...
▲小早川＊▲! Look, I was just...
You didn't even notice me, and I was standing right here...
I was just spacing out, that's all.
Uh-huh. Well, whatever... Anyway, I'm in a hurry.
Yeah, bye.
(That gave me a scare, but... she bought it for now, right？)
Kobayakawa
Hyah! Little kick.
Ouch！
You really leave yourself wide open.
I knew it was you, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Oh, I have to get going. I'm meeting up with a friend.
See you later.
